# @mission-platform/email-components

Server-rendered, email-client-compatible Forge JSX components built with Can I Email support constraints.

## Installation

Add it to a consuming workspace member:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mission-platform/email-components": "workspace:*"
  }
}
```

## Usage

```ts
import { EmailButton, EmailDocument, EmailTypography } from '@mission-platform/email-components';
import { renderEmail } from '@mission-platform/email-renderer';

const html = renderEmail(EmailDocument({
  children: EmailTypography({ children: 'Hello' }),
}), { title: 'Welcome' });
```

The same Forge tree can be previewed through the optional framework adapters
from `@mission-platform/email-renderer/vue`, `/react`, `/svelte`, `/solid`,
or `/web-components`, or through the aggregate `/adapters` entry. These
browser previews and `renderEmail` intentionally share the component tree.
